ground_truth.title: Galaxy S25 Ultra
ground_truth.main_content:
Galaxy S25 Ultra

From $1,299.99 before trade-in

Top features

Camera

Our most advanced AI ProVisual Engine

12MP Front Camera
200MP Wide-Angle Camera

Processor

The most powerful processor for Galaxy

Snapdragon 8 Elite for Galaxy

Battery

Long-lasting battery life to keep you going all day

5000mAh
Up to 31 hrs of video playback

Durability

Looks sleek, built tough and water resistant

Display

A display that adjusts to every moment

Simple. Impactful.

Galaxy S25 Ultra redefines the way you interact with your phone. An ergonomic exterior features smoother edges and a comfortable grip, while the redesigned One UI 7 streamlines every task.

Colors

Titanium Jetblack (Samsung.com only)
Titanium Jadegreen (Samsung.com only)
Titanium Pinkgold (Samsung.com only)
Titanium Silverblue
Titanium Black
Titanium Gray
Titanium Whitesilver

Thickness: 8.2 mm

Weight: 218 g

Looks sleek. Built tough.

A titanium frame keeps your Galaxy S25 Ultra strong and protected so you always have peace of mind.

Reinforced with Corning Gorilla Armor 2 display glass for a touchscreen as durable as it is beautiful.

IP68-rated water and dust resistance keep your Galaxy tech in top shape in any terrain.

The next evolution of Galaxy AI

Experience the next era of mobile AI with an AI companion that's one step ahead of your every need. Simply use natural conversation to check off everyday tasks with ease.

Press, talk, done

Streamline your day with an assistant that gets you. Ask Google Gemini to search for a pet-friendly vegan restaurant nearby and text it to your friend — your Galaxy S25 Ultra handles multiple tasks with a single ask.

Go live, get answers

Have free-flowing conversation with Gemini Live to brainstorm ideas or prepare for presentations on the go.

Stay ahead of your day

Get personalized briefings throughout the day from the all-new Now Brief. Start your morning with a weather and schedule overview, then get real-time updates like traffic alerts before your commute.

Filters just for you

Bring your pics to life with your own personalized filters. Galaxy AI will analyze your favorite photos and generate custom filters that match your style.

Energy Score

Sync with Galaxy Watch or Ring and receive insights including analysis of your sleep, activity and more.

Audio Eraser

Filter out background noise from your videos with Audio Eraser. Galaxy AI fine-tunes your sound so you can focus on what matters.

Circle to Search

Circle to Search with Google allows you to instantly search anything, even a song you hear or a video you watch.

Galaxy AI gives an award-worthy performance

Watch our spots that highlight incredible stunt work and see the latest Galaxy AI features in action.

Personal data stays personal

The Personal Data Engine combines and processes your primary data on-device, keeping it safe.

Have control over your Galaxy AI. You can decide where to process data for select features, either on your device or in the cloud.

The most advanced AI ProVisual Engine

Introducing our most advanced AI-powered pro-grade camera suite yet, complete with a 200MP Wide-Angle lens and an upgraded 50MP Ultra Wide lens for more detail in every frame.

12MP Front Camera
50MP Ultra Wide Camera
200MP Wide-Angle Camera
50MP Telephoto Camera
10MP Telephoto Camera

Nightography

Shoot in improved 10-bit HDR for a stunning videography experience. Our advanced processor delivers more precise noise removal meaning you won't have to worry about grainy night footage again.

Flow seamlessly from 1x to 100x with AI-enhanced Space Zoom and see further than you ever thought possible.

Performance

Introducing our most powerful processor, customized for Galaxy. With improved real-time ray tracing and Vulkan optimization, dive deep into the action with ultra-smooth gameplay thanks to Snapdragon 8 Elite Mobile Platform for Galaxy.

CPU: 37% faster processing
GPU: 30% improved graphics performance
NPU: 40% faster AI performance

Snapdragon 8 Elite for Galaxy

Watch videos up to 31 hrs

Store it all with 256GB, 512GB or 1TB of storage.

Switch effortlessly from iOS

Switching from iOS is easy. With Smart Switch, you can transfer your photos, videos, contacts and apps effortlessly.

Ecosystem

Sync Galaxy S25 Ultra with other Samsung devices in the Galaxy for smart, connected living.

- Galaxy Ring
- Galaxy Buds3 Pro
- Galaxy Watch Ultra
- Galaxy Tab S10 Ultra
